items.title: John Adams
items.description: John Adams was a Founding Father and the second president of the United States from 1797 to 1801. Before his presidency, he was a leader of the American Revolution that achieved independence from Great Britain. items.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
items.description: Legislative elections were held in Israel on 27 October 2026 to elect the 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: Sunny Ozell
items.description: Sunny Ozell, Lady Stewart is an American singer and songwriter who resides in Los Angeles, California. She was married to the English actor Sir Patrick Stewart until his death in 2026.

items.title: William Contreras
items.description: William Jesús Contreras, nicknamed "Wild Bill", is a Venezuelan professional baseball catcher for the Milwaukee Brewers of Major League Baseball (MLB).

items.title: Jacob Misiorowski
items.description: Jacob Walter Misiorowski, nicknamed "the Miz", is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers of Major League Baseball (MLB). items.title: Patrick Stewart on stage and screen
items.description: Patrick Stewart (1940–2026) was an English actor who had had an extensive career in film, television and on stage spanning over 60 years. Stewart won a Grammy Award and two Laurence Olivier Awards and was nominated for numerous accolades including three Golden Globe Awards, four Primetime Emmy Awards, three Screen Actors Guild Awards, and a Tony Award.
